modelOverview: Launched in 2007, the Ballon Bleu de Cartier is instantly recognisable for its curved, rounded case and the fluted crown set with a blue sapphire cabochon. The 33mm size sits at the smaller end of the range, making it a popular choice as a ladies' or unisex dress watch alongside the 36mm, 40mm and 42mm variants.

W6920068.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 076 (based on ETA 2670) · 28,800 vph · ~38h power reserve
W6920068.dial: Silvered guilloché opaline dial with 12 Roman numerals, blued-steel sword-shaped hands, sapphire crystal
W6920068.description: The Cartier Ballon Bleu 33mm ref. W6920068 is executed in solid 18k rose gold with a matching rose gold bracelet, distinguished by the model's signature rounded case, fluted sapphire-set crown and silvered guilloché dial. It runs on Cartier's automatic Calibre 076 (an ETA 2670 base). Every watch is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
